title: Local Well-posedness of a Diffuse Interface Two-phase Flow Model with Surfactants
summary: We establish the local well-posedness of strong solutions for a thermodynamically consistent diffuse interface model describing two-phase flows with surfactants, specifically the so-called Model C introduced by Garcke, Lam, and Stinner. Because of the non-standard, mixed-order strongly coupled structure of Model C, the classical Agmon-Douglis-Nirenberg theory and conventional Lopatinskii-Shapiro boundary conditions are not applicable due to divergent scaling behaviors.
